name: git-init-options
source:
%%{init: {'gitGraph': {'mainBranchName': 'trunk', 'mainBranchOrder': 2, 'showBranches': false, 'showCommitLabel': false, 'parallelCommits': true, 'rotateCommitLabel': false}, 'theme': 'forest'}}%%
gitGraph
  commit id: "seed" tag: "v0"
  branch dev order: 1
  commit id: "work" type: HIGHLIGHT
  checkout trunk
  merge dev id: "release"

name: git-frontmatter
source:
---
config:
  gitGraph:
    mainBranchName: trunk # root branch
    showBranches: true # keep names
    showCommitLabel: true # keep ids
---
gitGraph TB:
  commit id: "seed"
  branch "merge"
  commit id: "work"
  switch trunk
  merge "merge" id: "done" type: HIGHLIGHT tag: "v2"

name: mindmap-tree
source:
mindmap
  root((Plan))
    a[Build]
      Tests
    b(Ship)
      Review

name: mindmap-markdown-assets
source:
---
config:
  layout: tidy-tree
  mindmap:
    colorBy: depth
---
mindmap
  root(("`**Research** plan`"))::icon(fa fa-book):::large urgent
    a["`Read *sources*
then discuss`"]
      ::icon(mdi mdi-book)
      :::urgent large
        Evidence
      Questions
    Reader's notes; next steps

name: git-branch-order
source:
gitGraph TB:

  branch late order: 3
  commit id: "late"
  checkout main
  branch early order: 1
  commit id: "early"
  checkout main
  branch free
  commit id: "free"
  checkout main
  commit id: "finish"

name: git-main-order
source:
---
config:
  gitGraph:
    mainBranchName: trunk
    mainBranchOrder: 2 # move main after early
---
gitGraph TB:
  commit id: "seed"
  branch late order: 3
  commit id: "late"
  checkout trunk
  branch early order: 1
  commit id: "early"
  checkout trunk
  branch free
  commit id: "free"
  checkout trunk
  commit id: "finish"
